name: Hat of Wizardry

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Try a cantrip
powers.text: Once per dawn: cast a Wizard cantrip you don't know. Roll a d20 first: on a 1 the spell fails.

summary: Once a day, try to cast a Wizard cantrip you don't know.
text: Decorated with golden crescent moons and stars, this old-fashioned conical hat offers two benefits while worn. First, your Wizard spells can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. Second, you can attempt a cantrip you don't know, as long as it's a Wizard cantrip that takes an action to cast: roll an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10. On a success you cast it; on a failure the spell fizzles and the action is wasted. Either way, this property won't work again before you finish a Long Rest.
